tasks.title: Approve the functional test architecture
owners: Test architecture records owned by this task
steps: Ask Sol medium to derive required behavior from public contracts, production entry points, T01's inventory, and COMPONENT-MATRIX.md.
Require the architect to record case shape, oracle, fault model, environment, and limits before Luna writes the manifest.
Prefer integration/functional scenarios. Use an existing owner seam when the source requires it.

Prefer real user scenarios through production APIs and observable output.
Specify positive, negative, boundary, and recovery cases for each required behavior.
Name the production entry point, public API, observable result, independent oracle, and controlled environment for each case.
Use realistic controlled dependencies and faults at unowned external boundaries.
Never mock Termrock-owned production code. Use an external double only with a reviewed reason and fidelity record.
Define deterministic setup, inputs, clock, seed, tool versions, cleanup, and repeat rules.
Define red as a runtime assertion failure for a known defect or reviewed realistic fault.
Define green as the same assertion passing after correction or fault removal. Compiler or setup failures are not red evidence.
Record only the declared cases, source, tools, and environment as green. Do not claim absolute correctness.
Allow test-only timing or performance counters only as supplemental evidence under an approved contract.
Treat test count as inventory, not as a success metric.
Require an independent Sol medium review of every task-specific test plan before test edits.
If a scenario exposes a product gap, stop test edits. Require Sol medium testability-gap analysis first. Use Sol high only if the evidence requires a product architecture decision.
Keep T38 approval scoped to architecture. It does not approve later test changes.
